content.comment_body: Hello, does the [product_name] software include a monitoring mode?
Could you clarify your question? Which version of the software are you referring to?

Yes. In the upper area of the workspace, there is an icon for monitoring. However, it's not completely reliable—if you make small adjustments to a block, the software may indicate the programs differ, requiring you to upload the program again.

The simulation mode in [product_name] works well and accurately reflects the circuit operation. If you need to modify your program, you should exit simulation mode, make your changes, then re-enter simulation. If you encounter error messages from the software, it's likely an issue within your circuit. Also, below the work area on the right side, you might see an icon beside the main software icon. Clicking this lets you view error messages. See the attached file—hope it helps.
This isn't about simulation—it's about monitoring. [product_name] only offers online testing. For comprehensive monitoring, you need additional software.
Yes, [product_name] does have an online monitoring mode—see the attached image.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users discussed whether [product_name] includes a monitoring mode and its overall effectiveness. Some confirmed monitoring and simulation features, but there is ongoing confusion about their distinctions and limitations. Issues mentioned include unreliable monitoring—such as the need to re-upload programs after small changes—and differences between simulation and true live monitoring.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to provide a reliable built-in monitoring mode that displays live logic execution without requiring repetitive uploads or encountering technical challenges.
